# JVM Build Tools MCP Server 2.0.0-rc.1

This is a **breaking prerelease**. Existing 1.x clients must update their server configuration and refresh `tools/list` before using it.

- Configure an allowed project root locally. Calls that access project files are denied until a root is set; relative `projectDir` aliases keep absolute host paths out of model conversations.
- For HTTP, configure a bearer key and grant only the needed tool scopes. The public catalog now contains 24 explicitly scoped tools; sensitive and unfinished tools are withheld.
- Build calls return bounded, redacted diagnostic summaries instead of raw logs or source paths. Inspect local build output for the exact file or symbol when fixing a failure.
- Direct Maven `deploy` and sbt `publish` commands, plus Maven project/settings file selectors, are unavailable through the public executor. **Build scripts and plugins can still publish or access credentials** during allowed phases. Run untrusted projects in a credential-free isolated environment, preferably without network access.
- The bundled server negotiates MCP `2025-11-25` over stdio or Streamable HTTP. Selected official conformance scenarios passed; this is not a full conformance certification.

Start with the [2.0 quickstart](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.1/docs/user-guide/quickstart-v2.md), then read the [migration guide](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.1/docs/user-guide/migration-v2.md) and [architecture review](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.1/docs/reference/architecture.md).

Generated change notes follow below.
